pages.title: Evolutionary Games
pages.text: $(thing)Evolutionary Games$()$(br2)Let the winners have more offspring and the game plays itself: the mix a population settles into is the one nothing can invade. Unlocks the Evolutionarily Stable Strategy.

$(thing)Insight$(): 110$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Nash Equilibrium, Genomics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Genome Sample.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Fighters win a prize V; when two aggressive ones meet, both risk an injury costing C. When a share P of the population is aggressive, write how much more G an aggressive fighter earns than a timid one.
